panel.title: Feishu Connection
guideSteps: Create a custom app on the Feishu Open Platform and get the App ID / App Secret
Grant scopes: im:message, im:message:send_as_bot, im:resource, im:chat:readonly, contact:user.base:readonly (sender names)
Use long-connection event subscription (webhook mode requires a public callback URL) and subscribe to message receive events
Fill in App ID / App Secret in the config section above and enable the channel
Invite the bot into a group chat and @ it to start a conversation
panel.chatIdPlaceholder: Target chat ID (starts with oc_; have a member send a message first, then look it up via list_known_chats)
